reviewerOrPass: Worker A, same AI, separate source-first pass
method: Rebuilt the September 2026 Dutch Business Administration route from the adopted TiSEM appendix, the exact OSIRIS cohort plan and the underlying thesis, internship, supply-chain and research entries before rereading the frozen comparison.
findings: The appendix and 3A200-2026 plan have 30 EC in each semester. The first two years contain 12 compulsory units each and have an ordinary positive BSA threshold of 42 first-year EC. Distinct compulsory accounting, operations, supply chain, HR, management information and business practice courses are preserved, alongside the credit-bearing Competence Compass and uncredited GROW.

Third-year autumn contains a genuine 30 EC choice among exchange, an internship plus a TiSEM elective, two 15 EC school minors, or a 30 EC Tilburg minor. The 90 EC internship threshold applies if selected, with handbook conditions. The ordinary sequence can accumulate 150 EC before the final semester. The 12 EC thesis requires 120 EC in semester six or 138 EC from semester seven, plus syllabus requirements. Its catalogue entry describes independent business research and a defence.

The management schedule balances finance and marketing with strategy, negotiation and organisational behaviour. The analytics option has deeper statistics, programming, econometrics, databases and optimisation. The sustainability option integrates entrepreneurship and management with life-cycle work, resource recovery, governance and design. Resolved all six original offering conflicts. Pairwise differences are 75, 75 and 112.5 EC each way. No option claims Tilburg’s specialist supply-chain sequence.

Verified 29 external component titles and credits, 44 selected UCR titles and descriptions, three concepts, four note anchors, source links and qualified alignments. Optional UCR research is separate from scheduled credits and the Tilburg thesis.
